# P1.15 — Ingestion, full: Substack, URL, samples manager, PDF pipeline

Spec: `docs/tickets/43_P1.15__ingestion-full.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.15.md`
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests. Stage B (live Substack
discover→confirm→fetch + export-zip import + one priced visual-PDF reconstruction,
≤$5) is operator-gated → **D-P1.15-1**. Stacked on `stevevitali/p1-14-voices`;
merge operator-held.

## Summary

The §9.5 `Connection → DiscoveredItem → Sample(version)` framework at MVP scope, end
to end: a credential-free `Provider` interface (`discover`/`fetch`/`changeKey` over
injected `FetchPort`/`ConvertPort`/`BlobPort`/`SyncStore` — no connector ever accepts
a session token or cookie; paid/private content only ever arrives via the export-zip
path), the five MVP providers, the confirm-gated discover→sync engine with
`new`/`removed_remote`/changed diffing and AC-I-A hash deduplication, the Samples
tab (sources pane, items pane, quality drawer, read-only preview + version history),
the five-verdict PDF pipeline with priced reconstruction and the opt-in visual tier,
canonical Markdown, sniffed-type caps, the never-cookies CI gate, and the
tombstone→purge half of voice deletion.

**`@rhema/ingest`** (NEW package): `types.ts` — `ConnectionRef` carries id/provider/
handle/autoInclude/schedule only; `ProviderDeps` carries `fetch`/`blobs`/`clock` only —
the credential-free shape is structural, not conventional. `providers/substack.ts` —
origin normalization, archive paging, `/feed` fallback on archive 404, `access≠everyone`
items listed as *Paywalled — import your export* and never fetched, `updated_at`→body-hash
`changeKey`, footnote `[^n]` normalization. `providers/substack-export.ts` — jszip +
RFC-4180 CSV, `posts.csv` + `posts/*.html` into the same item pipeline (paid posts in an
export are first-class samples). `providers/url.ts` — one-item discovery,
ETag→Last-Modified→body-hash change detection, paywall markers → `partial` + note.
`providers/manual.ts` — upload/paste connections without discovery. `sync.ts` — the diff
engine: persist-before-fetch, explicit confirm before bodies move, `removed_remote`
retains bytes and stays in the corpus, verbatim provider error + remedy persisted on the
connection, last-good version retained on failure, a new `sample_versions` row only when
the normalized body hash changes (AC-I-A), auto-sync never auto-includes. `canonical.ts` —
`assembleImportedDoc`-based canonical Markdown with front-matter provenance
(title/date/source URL/fetched-at/original+content hashes/quality), content-addressed
images via the blob port, no body H1. `caps.ts` — the format allowlist + 25 MB / 200k-word
/ 50-file caps enforced on sniffed type.

**Convert** (`apps/convert`): per-page PDF text extraction with scan/garbled heuristics →
`clean`/`partial`/`unreadable`/`empty` verdicts + quality notes. Still strictly no-network
— the LLM passes are worker jobs, never inside convert (asserted).

**API** (`apps/api/src/ingest-routes.ts`): `POST /voices/:id/connections` (discover +
persist; zero body fetches), `…/confirm` (per-item include/omit; free default-in,
paid/unknown default-out), `…/sync` (enqueue `ingest.sync`), sources list + settings +
remove (soft detach — items retained), `GET …/samples/:itemId` (read-only preview +
version history + quality data), `GET …/raw` (original bytes for the side-by-side),
export-zip import via the quarantine key, `POST …/reconstruct`/`…/revisual` (estimate +
cap shown first; `confirmed:true` enqueues the metered job — `RECONSTRUCT_PRICING`
4/8 + 180/240 credits), `DELETE /voices/:id` (tombstone → `voice.purge`).

**Worker** (`apps/worker/src/ingest-jobs.ts` + `main.ts`): `ingest.sync` consumer over the
engine (bounded convert wait via `jobConvertPort`), `ingest.reconstruct` — metered via
`sqlSampleMeter` (bucket-ordered debit, idempotent), `ingest.sync.sweep` (daily `03:40`
cron — enqueues `auto:true` syncs for `schedule='daily'` connections; never auto-includes),
`voice.purge` (cascade: samples, sample_versions, discovered items, connections, retained
quarantine bytes, profile rows — forked house-style references survive). Live seams bound:
`createFetcherServicePort` (invoker-gated POST /fetch, OIDC per hop — LIVE FINDING 11
pattern), `createGcsBlobStore` (IngestBlobs over user-content), convert-Job preview,
`AnthropicReconstructor` (text tier → `claude-haiku-4-5` repair pass on degraded
extraction; visual tier → `claude-sonnet-5` with the raw PDF as a `document` block —
`acceptsDocumentBytes`, no raster step; the visual document-read IS the spec's
"GCP document-OCR equivalent" substitution for Textract — recorded in the run ledger).
Each seam is optional-env-driven and fails closed with a named reason
(`live fetcher not wired` / `blob_store_unconfigured` / `convert_unconfigured` /
`reconstructor_unconfigured`).

**Fetcher**: the content-type allowlist gains `application/rss+xml`/`atom+xml`/`xml` +
`text/xml` — without it the Substack `/feed` fallback would 403 `content_type` live.
The boundary is unchanged: parses nothing, returns bytes + metadata.

**Web + api-client**: the Samples tab rework — sources pane (status, last sync, verbatim
error + remedy, Re-sync, remove), items pane (include/omit retaining bytes, quality
badges, ★ held-out post-reveal, "changed since profile", filter/sort), corpus summary,
Add menu (Link publication, export zip, file, URL, paste), item preview page (read-only
Markdown + version history + the quality drawer with *Re-convert with visual ≈180 cr* —
opt-in only, estimate before consent), and the voice delete surface. Form parsing moved
to all-fields mode so the per-item checkbox set round-trips.

**Never-cookies gate (AC-I-B)**: `scripts/check-no-cookies.mjs` +
`pnpm check:no-cookies` + a CI `public-safe` step — scans the ingestion surfaces
(`@rhema/ingest`, ingest routes/jobs + tests incl. fixtures, web Samples surfaces,
api-client bundle, `connections` schema surface, OpenAPI docs) for credential-shaped
fields/headers/form inputs; 28 files, clean.

**Infra** (`infra/pulumi`): `FETCHER_SERVICE_URL` on api + worker;
`USER_CONTENT_BUCKET`/`CONVERT_JOB`/`CONVERT_JOB_ROOT`/`INGEST_MODEL_KEY_SECRET` on the
worker; api+worker → fetcher `roles/run.invoker`; worker → convert Job
`jobsExecutorWithOverrides` + `run.viewer`; worker → user-content `objectAdmin`;
worker → `anthropic-api-key` `secretAccessor`. Service creation order adjusted so
`fetcher` exists before api/worker reference it.

## Test evidence

- `pnpm turbo build lint typecheck` — **126/126** tasks green.
- `pnpm test` — **339 files / 3,057 pass / 2 skip**. (The known `lever-matrix` 100 ms
  parallel-load flake did not trip on the final run; an earlier run showed the documented
  152 ms vs 16 ms isolated signature — pre-existing, unchanged.)
- `pnpm check:no-cookies` — 28 ingestion-surface files scanned, **0** credential
  constructs (the two line-level annotations mark the worker's own egress model key —
  not a connector credential).
- `pnpm check:licenses` — 606 OK. `pnpm check:protocol-markers` — 42 clean.
- `check-build-memory.sh .` — 0 violations. `infra/pulumi` typechecks clean.
- New/extended deterministic suites: `packages/ingest` (`ingest.test.ts`,
  `substack.test.ts` — instrumented zero-body-discover assert, `/feed` fallback,
  changeKey order, paywall refusal; export-zip fixture tests; sync/diff/AC-I-A; caps;
  canonical), `apps/convert` (verdict fixtures + no-network), `apps/api`
  `ingest-routes.test.ts` (8 PGlite suites — persist-before-fetch, confirm+sync+preview,
  omit-retains-bytes, priced enqueues, delete tombstone, credential-shaped provider
  rejection), `apps/worker` `ingest-jobs.test.ts` (end-to-end sync over fake ports,
  metered reconstruct, sweep, purge cascade + fork guard), `apps/web`
  `voice-surfaces.test.ts` (panes, badges, drawer, repeated-field confirm post),
  `live-clients` `ingest.test.ts` (+3 — the fetcher port wire shape, deny mapping,
  unreachable fails closed).

| AC | Status |
|---|---|

| Substack archive/`access`/export-CTA/`/feed`/`updated_at` changeKey | ✅ `substack.test.ts` |
| Export zip `posts.csv`+`posts/*.html`; paid posts first-class | ✅ fixture-zip tests |
| Include/omit retains bytes; `removed_remote` kept; verbatim error+remedy; last-good | ✅ `ingest-routes`/`ingest-jobs` tests |

| Auto-sync never auto-includes; manual default | ✅ sweep → `auto:true`; `state:'new'` rows |
| PDF verdicts + drawer + priced passes, never inside convert | ✅ converters verdict tests + pricing + `AnthropicReconstructor` seam |
| Canonical Markdown + read-only preview + versions; edit = new piece | ✅ `canonical.ts` + preview routes |
| Formats/caps on sniffed type; over-cap listed/auto-omitted/counted | ✅ `caps.ts` tests |
| AC-I-B — CI grep clean over ingestion UI/schema/OpenAPI/client | ✅ `check:no-cookies` → CI `public-safe` |
| Voice delete cascades within retention; forked refs survive | ✅ `voice.purge` + fork-guard test |
| Gates green; ledgers updated; `D-P1.15-*` ids | ✅ this PR + run ledger + D-P1.15-1 |

## Not in this PR (Stage B → D-P1.15-1)

`pulumi up` (the new env vars + invoker/bucket/Job/secret grants), a real Substack
archive discover→confirm→fetch against a public newsletter, one export-zip import
through the live quarantine→convert path, one priced reconstruction + one opt-in
visual-tier re-conversion — all metered, hard-capped at **$5** (fetches are $0; the two
model passes are the spend). No merge is performed by the implementer.

REQs satisfied: REQ-INGEST-1…14 (MVP scope — providers beyond Substack remain 1.x per
the matrix); AC-I-A, AC-I-B; ledger I6/I7 closed where this ticket was their open half.
